free_tier.stated: 10 GB-month storage, 1M Class A and 10M Class B operations per month, egress free
free_tier.notes: Standard storage only; the free tier does not apply to Infrequent Access. Above it, Standard storage costs USD 0.015 / GB-month, Class A operations USD 4.50 / million requests and Class B operations USD 0.36 / million requests; usage rounds up to the next billing unit (1.1 GB-month bills as 2 GB-month).

per_object_cap.stated: 5 TiB per object (5 GiB less than 5 TiB, so 4.995 TiB); one upload request or part carries at most 4.995 GiB (5 MiB less than 5 GiB), up to 10,000 parts

retention.stated: not applicable: bytes persist while the account is in good standing

egress.terms: free for every storage class when read directly from R2 (Workers API, S3 API, r2.dev); metered services connected to a bucket may charge for their part, and Infrequent Access reads carry a USD 0.01 / GB data-retrieval fee
egress.free_allowance: none for egress: egress to the internet is free on every plan

chaining: the origin that makes a free front free: R2 holds the bytes with zero egress and a Cloudflare front serves them, so the read path costs nothing at any volume and the 10 GB is the whole bill.

limits.value: 1M Class A and 10M Class B operations per month
4.995 TiB per object (5 TiB less 5 GiB); 4.995 GiB per upload request or part
10 GB-month of Standard storage free each month; storage above it is billed at USD 0.015 / GB-month
r2.dev public endpoint: variable rate limit, HTTP 429 above hundreds of requests per second, bandwidth may be throttled; a custom domain carries no such stated limit

identity_cost.detail: A Cloudflare account (sign-up form: email and password; the address is verified by a mailed message) plus an R2 subscription added through a dashboard checkout, which needs a valid payment method on file even for the free monthly usage: a card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, UnionPay), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, or a USDC stablecoin wallet whose permit covers R2 usage charges. A billing address is confirmed with the payment method, and gift or pre-payment cards may be refused for lacking one. No R2 API token can be created before the purchase. A phone number or a manual review at the checkout: unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: a failed payment-method preauthorization blocks access to the buckets (requests return errors), and the data may be deleted if the payment method is not updated within 30 days
